subject: Load onramp: slotting & routing playbook
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@vectorapps.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hands-on POC + load onramp (week of Aug 22)

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Vector Apps is excited to run a short POC focused on inference scaling and routing. Our goals: validate throughput up to ~200 r/s for the primary prompt set, keep p50 latency <100ms and p95 <250ms, and verify router fallbacks under a single-region outage.

We'd like a 90-minute hands-on kickoff where we:
- walk the prompt set and prompt-safety constraints,
- validate routing policies (latency-first vs cost-first),
- run a 30m steady-state load window followed by a 10m stress ramp.

Preferred week: Aug 22–26. Timezone: PDT (we're in SF). Can you propose 2–3 slots? We can give access to our test harness (GitHub link below) and a procurement contact for any SSO/KMS paperwork. I attached a short requirements doc (vector-onramp-requirements.docx).

Links: https://github.com/vectorapps/test-harness
Attaching: vector-onramp-requirements.docx (docx)

Cheers,
Alex Jensen
CTO, Vector Apps
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@vectorapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on POC + load onramp (week of Aug 22)

Alex — thanks for the clear goals and the repo. Glad to run this.

Slots I can offer (90 minutes):
- Tue Aug 23, 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Wed Aug 24, 13:00–14:30 PDT
- Thu Aug 25, 08:30–10:00 PDT (earlier)

Proposed agenda (we'll circulate a formal runbook before the session):
1) 10m intro and scope confirmation
2) 25m prompt review + routing policy walk-through
3) 45m load window + observation (steady state + ramp)
4) 10m immediate follow-ups and next steps

Pre-reqs we need from you:
- test harness access (GitHub invite)
- list of prompt variations + rough traffic split (we can import these into the playbook)
- long-lived API key or short-lived token for the session (we recommend short-lived)

We'll attach our initial playbook draft (RDW_Onramp_Playbook_v1.pdf) and a short checklist. Can you confirm which of the slots works and whether Vector Apps prefers an on-site screen share or us to run the generator from your harness?

I attached: RDW_Onramp_Playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

- Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: hands-on POC + load onramp (week of Aug 22) — internal coordination

Following Alex's ask — internal checklist and owners before Wed: 

Owners / bullets:
- Marissa: confirm sales kickoff invites and get procurement contact copied (procurement@vectorapps.com). Drive calendar invite once slot confirmed.
- Dylan: please validate the playbook's load generator commands (we used vegeta last time) and prepare a short guide to set client-side concurrency for Vector's harness.
- Rishi: double-check capacity for a 200 r/s steady state with our dedicated pool (what's the expected token mix? assume avg 75 tokens/resp). Confirm whether we need to pin a model variant for stability.

Immediate asks (today):
1) Dylan — paste the sample vegeta command and target file into the shared doc.
2) Rishi — quick capacity estimate and any recommended quantization (int8 ok?).
3) Marissa — confirm that procurement has the SSO form; if not, I will loop in legal.

Forwarded message (external) attached below for context.

— Naomi

Subject: Re: Request: hands-on POC + load onramp (week of Aug 22) — slot confirmed

Naomi / team — thanks. Wed Aug 24 13:00–14:30 PDT works for us. Adding Priya Raman (head of platform) and our SRE alias so they can vet the run.

A couple notes:
- We'll run the generator from our harness (we'll give you a runner VM and short-lived token).
- For token mix, expect avg ~60–90 tokens per response for the primary prompts, a small subset of long-form responses (200–300 tokens) at 10% traffic.
- Procurement will ask for an invoice template and a short SOC 2 evidence bundle (we can provide both in advance).

We'll accept the playbook PDF as a starting point; if you have a 10–15 minute pre-brief within your team prior to Wed (internal dry-run), let us know.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@vectorapps.com>, procurement@vectorapps.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on POC + load onramp (week of Aug 22) — final confirmations + slight reschedule

Alex / Priya — quick update after our internal dry-run. We're all set on the playbook, but Dylan spotted an overlap with another lab booking at 13:00 PDT on Wed. Can we nudge the session 30 minutes later to 13:30–15:00 PDT? That keeps the 90-minute window intact and gives us time to finish the pre-checks.

If the new slot works, I'll:
- send the updated calendar invite,
- post the final runbook (shared doc) with vegeta commands and target file,
- attach an invoice template for procurement, and
- provide a short-lived token at T-10 minutes for the Vector runner.

If the time doesn't work, we can keep Wed 13:00 and Dylan will attend from a separate pool — but 13:30 would be smoother.

Apologies for the late tweak — wanted to avoid a noisy handover mid-run.

Thanks,
Naomi

--
